tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). v2.3.1 was marked unhealthy in production. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, using the rollback action. The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollout to all regions. Current state: v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west; healthy=true; error rate 0.002. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and is healthy again, with error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 was the failing release. No change-manager approval was needed because v2.3.0 had been healthy in production.
- **Rollback issue:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I retried the same rollback, and it completed across all regions.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. The summary covers the failure, the rollback, the partial failure and retry, and the current state. The first incident request timed out, so I retried it with the same idempotency key, and only one incident was created.

Follow-up items for the on-call engineer: find out why v2.3.1 failed health checks, and why the orchestrator halted the first rollout. Do not redeploy v2.3.1 until that is understood.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy one currently running in all three regions. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback reported a partial failure after us-east. I'll check the current state before doing anything else.
us-east is now on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. The rollout halted with an orchestrator error, so I'll retry the same rollback once to finish the remaining regions.
The rollback completed and checkout-api is healthy. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
